convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorRMACD indicator and includes external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic. Custom indicator with non-standard parameters makes auto-conversion unreliable.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for calculation
derived_values.formula: max(Fast_RVI, Slow_TRVI+8) + GetStartBars(Signal_Method, Signal_XMA, Signal_Phase) + 3 + SignalBar

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position (BuyPosClose/SellPosClose toggled by input)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative MM values = fixed lot size (abs value); Positive MM values = share of deposit in a deal

custom_logic_notes: EA implements 4 selectable trading algorithms via AlgMode enum: (1) 'breakdown' - RMACD crosses zero, (2) 'MACDtwist' - RMACD histogram changes direction, (3) 'SIGNALtwist' - signal line changes direction, (4) 'MACDdisposition' - RMACD histogram crosses signal line. SignalBar input allows choosing which bar index to read (0=current, 1=previous confirmed bar). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are input toggles that gate each direction independently. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with deal time tracking via GlobalVariableDel_.
python_conversion_notes: Must reverse-engineer ColorRMACD indicator logic or obtain its source code. The RMACD indicator uses volume-weighted moving averages (RVI/TRVI based on VOLUME_TICK) with configurable smoothing (SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA) for the signal line. SmoothAlgorithms.mqh provides the CXMA class with 9+ smoothing methods - these must be reimplemented or substituted with standard TA-lib equivalents. TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles position open/close with global variable persistence - must replicate the deal-time tracking and duplicate-trade prevention logic. The 4 algorithm modes are straightforward once the indicator is replicated. Position sizing logic (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) needs careful translation. SL/TP values appear to be in points (not pips) so digit adjustment may be implicit in the TradeAlgorithms.mqh implementation - verify with source.
